_comment: Per-cell regression baseline for gate.mjs. `defaults` applies to every composed cell; `cells.<id>` overrides one cell (set `mustPass: false` to waive a cell, or narrow `requiredExpectations`). Starting posture per the WP7 brief: every L1 deterministic assert is REQUIRED for all cells; the judge dims are advisory and never gate. The assert vocabulary is L1_ASSERTS in cells.mjs — gate failures name any drift.

l2._comment: L2 asserts gate only the cells an L2 run admitted (see gate.mjs expectedCellsFor). budget_cap incompletes fail the gate unless --allow-budget-cap.
